title: Red Oak Technologies
description: redoaktech.com Red Oak Technologies private IT staffing and managed services company founded in 1995 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with offices in Austin and Denver. It has about 250 employees across 5 countries and estimated revenue of roughly 105 million dollars. The company provides contract tech talent, direct hire and full project delivery with offshore and nearshore teams. It specializes in cloud, DevOps, semiconductor and life sciences clients from startups to Fortune 500. Led by President Joel Leege, ex-Randstad Technology, it has completed over 1700 projects in 30 years with 92 percent client retention.
